Notes
Comis Hotel & Golf Resort – Santon, Isle of Man
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Hours: Full-Time | Permanent

We are looking for an experienced Spa Manager or a Senior Beauty/Spa Therapist who is ready to take the next step into management to join Comis Hotel & Golf Resort.
This is an excellent opportunity for either an established Spa Manager or an experienced Senior Therapist with strong leadership potential who is looking to progress their career.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate and develop our team of Spa Therapists.
Deliver professional spa treatments to a high technical standard.
Manage bookings, rotas, scheduling and daily spa operations.
Drive treatment, retail and revenue performance.
Monitor costs, targets and departmental KPIs.
Maintain excellent guest service, cleanliness and presentation standards.
Ensure compliance with health & safety and company procedures.
Support the promotion of spa services, offers and social media activity.

About You
NVQ Level 3 Beauty/Spa Therapy qualification or equivalent – essential.
Experience as a Spa Manager, Spa Supervisor or Senior Beauty/Spa Therapist.
Strong practical treatment skills and a passion for wellness and guest care.
Leadership experience or the confidence and ability to take the next step into a management role.
Commercial awareness and the ability to work towards treatment, retail and revenue targets.
Excellent communication, organisation and people skills.
Confident using booking and scheduling systems.
Flexible to work weekends and variable hours as required.
Knowledge of Elemis products would be advantageous.

What We Offer
Competitive salary based on experience.
Service charge participation.
Relocation assistance.
Staff meals and uniform.
Hotel and staff discounts.
Recognition and reward schemes.
Free on-site parking.
Training and career development opportunities.

The opportunity to progress into spa management and develop your leadership career.

To apply, please send your CV and cover letter to HR@comishotel.com.

Applicants must be eligible to work in the Isle of Man.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

STRICTLY NO AGENCIES

Notes
We are seeking an experienced, reliable and highly organised Private Housekeeper to join a busy family household in Douglas.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who takes genuine pride in maintaining a home to an exceptional standard and enjoys a varied role where they can work independently and take ownership of their responsibilities.

The position is within a large private family home and will involve high-standard housekeeping and cleaning, laundry and ironing, clothing care, preparation and organisation of school uniforms, changing beds and managing household linen, keeping wardrobes, cupboards and household areas organised, grocery shopping, managing household supplies and deliveries, and some light household administration.

We are looking for someone who is naturally proactive and organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to recognise what needs to be done without requiring constant direction.

Discretion and trustworthiness are extremely important. The successful candidate will be respectful of the family's privacy, dependable, professional and comfortable working independently within a private home.

Previous experience within a private household, professional housekeeping, hotel housekeeping or a high-standard domestic environment would be highly desirable.

We are happy to consider different working patterns and can offer flexibility around hours for the right person. However, availability for a half-day on Saturday is essential.

A full driving licence is essential due to the nature of the position.

Applicants must have the appropriate right or permission to work in the Isle of Man, or be able to obtain any permission required for the role.
To apply, please send your CV to allison@trillionmediagroup.com

Position: Trainee Drainage Repair Technician

Drainage Consultants Ltd is looking for a hardworking and motivated Trainee Drainage Repair Technician to join our team.

We’re looking for someone who is eager to learn, willing to get stuck in and interested in developing their skills within the drainage industry. Previous drainage experience is an advantage, but we’re happy to train the right person who has a positive attitude and a strong work ethic.

Key Responsibilities

Carry out drainage repairs, maintenance and inspections.

Respond to emergency drainage call-outs.

Use specialist equipment and tools to diagnose and resolve drainage issues.

Assist with blockages and other drainage-related work.

Provide a professional service to customers.

Requirements:

Full driving licence.

A strong work ethic and willingness to learn.

Punctual and able to work well as part of a team.

Good practical and problem-solving skills.

Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and respond to emergency call-outs.

Previous experience in drainage, construction or a similar trade is beneficial but not essential.

What We Offer

Full training for the right candidate.

The opportunity to develop practical skills and build a career in the drainage industry.

A varied role with opportunities to learn and progress.

If you’re hardworking and ready to learn, we’d love to hear from you.

Notes
MANX WORKERS ONLY - Locals or work permit holders.
We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member.
South of the Island - Please note that you must have your own transport for our remote location.

vacancies@bdc.im

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role
Position: Front of House (FOH).
Hours: 25-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends).
Pay: Minimum wage.
Location: South of the island.
Own transport: Essential.
What You'll Be Doing
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe.
Greet, assist and seat guests.
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH).
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food).
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards.
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals.
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service.
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service.
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed.
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers.
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation.
Filing of delivery notes and invoices.
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items.
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies.
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required.
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback.
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling.
Always maintain a professional appearance.
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners.
About You
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred.
Own reliable transport is essential.
Warm, friendly and customer-focused.
Reliable, punctual and well-presented.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team.
Good communication skills and a positive attitude.
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends.
What We Offer
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment.
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster.
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.
How to Apply
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im 

We can't wait to welcome the right person to the team!

Notes
The Warehouse Supervisor is a key leadership role that bridges the gap between our transport office, 
warehouse floor, and Class 2 drivers.  In this position, you will assume full operational accountability for the physical movement of goods, warehouse efficiency, and the strategic management of both the administrative and delivery drivers. You will be responsible for coordinating, scheduling, delivering island wide and managing our team of drivers and handling warehouse stock control. This is a hands-on management role that requires both strategic problem-solving and excellent interpersonal skills to resolve customer queries and 
lead your team effectively. 

Key Responsibilities :
Directly manage, shift-schedule, and train warehouse administrators and delivery drivers. 
Plan and schedule daily delivery runs across the Isle of Man, maximizing fuel efficiency and 
timing accuracy. 
Establish operational goals, evaluate team performance, and build a culture of safety and 
accountability. 
Strategically align the daily delivery booking schedule with physical warehouse capacity and 
staffing levels. 
Coordinate with the transport team to ensure incoming stock is processed, inspected, and 
allocated correctly. 
Act as the main escalation point for customer inquiries, delivery delays, or challenges. 
Investigate and resolve discrepancies between system records and physical warehouse 
stock. 
Supervise the physical staging and secure loading of home delivery vehicles to ensure transit 
safety and zero-damage delivery. 
Oversee the dispatch process to guarantee on-time departures and strict adherence to 
customer delivery windows.

Qualifications & Skills Required: 
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in logistics, transport management, or warehouse operations. 
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to lead by example, diffuse stressful situations, and maintain high team morale. 
Ability to assist with manual handling and lifting of heavy, bulky items when operational demands require a hands-on approach. 
Forklift licence (Desirable).

For more details and to apply contact Gabbie@mic.co.im

Notes
An opportunity exists for a suitably experienced and motivated individual to join the team at the
Southern Civic Amenity Site in the position of Site Operative.
The successful candidate will assist with the day-to-day operations on site and assist customers
ensuring that only domestic and registered commercial customer waste is accepted at the Site,
keep the site clean and tidy and be responsible for the completion and submission of relevant
documentation ensuring that the site complies with and is operated according to the Waste
Licence, Working Plan and instructions set by the Board.
Should the successful candidate hold an appropriate 360 Excavator Licence they will operate
plant, machinery and vehicles as required. Successful candidates will be required to undertake
training to obtain and/or maintain the appropriate licence.
The Southern Civic Amenity Site Board is a joint local authority Board consisting of
representatives of the five Southern local authorities to oversee the operation of the
Southern Civic Amenity Site. The Southern Civic Amenity Site is open 7 days per week to
provide effective and efficient operation of the site for the benefit of the public. To ensure
an equitable spread of the workdays amongst the staff, a working pattern of 4 days on / 2
days off on a rolling 13-week rota, including weekends is in place. Normal hours are
7.30am to 4.30pm, with an unpaid lunch break. The rota averages approximately 37 paid
hours per week.
Applications close at midday Friday 6th November 2026.
For more details and an application form, please contact the undersigned.
J M Roberts
Clerk to Southern Civic Amenity Site Board
Castletown Road
Port St Mary
IM9 5LS.

Gloryland Preschool Nursery has an exciting opportunity for the right candidate to take on the role of Manager in our 2+ nursery. The successful candidate will be expected to work as part of our management team and provide a high standard of physical, social, and emotional care for children aged 2-5 years. As Manager you will play an important role in leading by example, supporting fellow staff members, and working together as a team to provide an enabling environment in which all children can learn, play and develop. 
It is essential that the candidate must have excellent person skills and maintain a strong relationship with parents, a minimum of Level 3 qualification in childcare and 2 years post qualification experience. Furthermore, a full DBS check will be required.
To apply please email your CV to ama@gloryland.im

WE’RE GROWING! JOIN THE HAPPY DAYS FAMILY!

Are you a qualified Level 3 Nursery Practitioner who is passionate about helping little ones learn, grow and thrive? We’d love to hear from you!

At Happy Days Nursery, we believe every child deserves to feel safe, valued and supported in an environment where learning is celebrated, individuality is valued and every child is supported to reach their full potential.

We’re looking for a caring, fun and enthusiastic practitioner to join our friendly team. Someone who brings energy, kindness and positivity to each day, loves planning exciting, playful activities and isn’t afraid to embrace the great outdoors in all weathers!

You’ll play an important role in creating meaningful experiences, supporting children’s individual development and helping them build confidence, independence and a love of learning. We want someone who shares our passion for early years, enjoys working as part of a team and understands the difference that warmth, encouragement and imagination can make.

What we’re looking for:
 A relevant Level 3 childcare qualification, A genuine passion for children’s learning and development, A caring, fun and enthusiastic approach, Someone who is proactive, team-focused and ready to get involved.

If you’re ready to bring your passion, creativity and enthusiasm to Happy Days Nursery and help make a difference in little lives every single day, we’d love to hear from you!

Interested? Send Grace, our manager, your CV and cover letter, or drop us a message to find out more!

Hello@happydaysnursery.im

Manx Wildlife Trust is seeking a Biodiversity Educator to deliver environmental education and engagement activities for schools, community groups and public audiences across the Isle of Man. The role includes planning and delivering learning sessions, developing educational resources, supporting events and helping to increase understanding of biodiversity and conservation. Applicants should have experience in education, environmental engagement, interpretation or a related field, together with strong communication, organisational and practical skills. The post is 18.75 hours per week, worked on Wednesday afternoons and full days on Thursdays and Fridays, with some evening and weekend work required. To apply, please send a CV (maximum two pages) and a cover letter to Dr Carmel Croukamp at carmel@mwt.im.

We are looking for an experienced, caring and reliable Nanny to join a busy family on the Isle of Man.

The family has six children, with the youngest aged 2 and at home during the day. The role will focus on caring for the youngest child during school hours, while also supporting the wider family routine before and after school.

The preferred schedule is Monday to Friday, 7am–7pm, one week on / one week off, although alternative hours may be considered for the right candidate.

Duties include childcare, school and activity routines, preparing children's meals, laundry and general household organisation.

We are looking for someone warm, patient and organised with previous professional childcare or nannying experience. Childcare qualifications, paediatric first aid and a full driving licence would be advantageous.

Competitive salary depending on experience and agreed working pattern.

To apply email jo@recruitmentworks.im or call 629 676

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team. The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times. Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience. Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position. Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities. Why Join Prospero Group? We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave. Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us. To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

Notes
Temp for 6 months with the possibility to go perm.
Mill-Turn Manufacturing Engineer – RLC Ronaldsway
RLC Ronaldsway is a world class provider of components & services to the Aerospace industry.
We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to support our CNC machining division.
Reporting to the Engineering Manager, the suitable candidate must demonstrate a proven track record of defining and delivering efficient CNC machining processes for Mill-Turn CNC machines. Strong fundamentals in CAD, CAD/CAM and CNC machining are required.
We seek a person with a “can do” attitude to work as part of the team with minimal supervision to deliver world-class results. Working in a structured and meticulous manner, you will be an integral part of an engineering department that defines and implements efficient defect-free manufacturing processes.
In support of an established aerospace machining and finishing company, the Manufacturing Engineer will be required to:
Work effectively within a cross-functional team to develop and deliver manufacturing processes in line with existing guidelines, on time, and within budget.
Have a good understanding of CNC manufacturing processes for low batch medium/high complexity machining.
Interpret customer drawings, CAD models and specifications.
Assist in providing NPI feasibility estimations and prove-out validation.
Provide hands-on technical and operator training for new and existing machining processes.
Work hands-on with machinists to develop new products.
Knowledge of Edgecam, Vericut, Mazatrol, Alkart Wizard, and Fanuc G-code preferred.
Efficient in the use of 3D CAD systems. E.g., Solidworks.
Experience in fixture design.
Robust problem-solving/Root cause analysis skills
Demonstrate lean implementation and sustainability.
Be an effective communicator between all relevant stakeholders.
Understanding databases and the Microsoft Office suite of software.
Provide technical support to customers, production cells and project teams.
Define process flow for new and current projects using manufacturing system design tools and methodology.
Candidates with experience in programming sliding head machines (citizens) will particularly interest the company.
Qualifications:
 Engineering qualification HNC/HND is essential, however degree qualified in a relevant Engineering discipline is preferred.
 Consideration will be given to those who can demonstrate the required level of experience and process understanding.
This position offers an attractive salary, cash joining incentive of £1,250 (paid on completion of successful probationary period), competitive company pension scheme, simply health care plan, positive team environment, and more importantly the opportunity to advance your career in a strong group with an impressive portfolio and focus on employee development.

For more details and to apply contact 01624820555.

Notes
The Lead Yard Hand plays a central role in the daily running of the charity.  Ensuring high standards of animal care, smooth operation of public facing areas and effective coordination of staff and volunteers.  As a key part of a small team, the post holder will need to be practical, flexible and ready to turn to a wide range of daily tasks. This role supports the general manager and provides first-line to two yard hands and our team of volunteers, helping to maintain a safe, welcoming environment for our animals, visitors, and volunteers. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Deliver high-quality daily care for the wildlife ensuring high welfare standards are consistently met, Lead by example in the yard duties including feeding, mucking out, grooming, and monitoring animals health. Support the general manager with organising daily routines, seasonal tasks and farm maintenance. Carry out basic repairs on the farm e.g. the fences and buildings. Undertake gardening, including grass cutting and strimming. Ensure safe use of farm equipment and machinery. TEAM LEADERSHIP: Provide day-to-day supervision, guidance, and support of two yard hands and volunteers. Assist with staff training, task allocation and maintaining a positive, collaborative working environment. Act as a point of contact for operational issues when the general manager is off site. Induct, train and support volunteers, ensuring they feel valued, confident and equipped for their roles. Foster a welcoming, inclusive culture for volunteers of all ages and backgrounds. GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide assistance in the cafe and shop, ensuring high standards and excellent customer service. Manage cash handling and reconciliation. Act as an ambassador for the charity, providing friendly, knowledgeable engagement with the public. Support seasonal events such as Easter, Halloween, and Christmas, helping to create enjoyable experiences for visitors.  Work flexibly as a small team that operates 365 days a year. Use initiative to solve problems and respond to unexpected situations calmly and effectively. Maintain high standards of health and safety across all areas on site. Uphold the values, reputation and long history of the home of rest. ESSENTIAL CRITERIA : At least 2 years experience working with horses and confidence handling animals of varying ages and temperaments. Excellent customer service skills. Full drivers licence. Flexible with working hours and tasks, including cover for events and annual leave. Comfortable working outdoors in all seasons and able to to carry out the hands-on nature of the role. Ability to carry out basic repairs around the farm. Strong problem solving skills and working on your own initiative. Experience working with or coordinating people and guiding or supporting people. DESIRERABLE CRITERIA: Ability to use farm equipment e.g. tractors, mowers, catering experience. Relevant certifications such as chainsaw operation or machinery use.

For more details and to apply contact laura@iomhorseshome.im

Why HSBC
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
As an HSBC employee in the Channel Islands and Isle of Man (CIIOM) you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all employees, enhanced parental and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a non-contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.
The Opportunity
HSBC Channel Islands and Isle of Man (CIIOM) is seeking a Relationship Support Analyst to support Relationship Directors within our Corporate & Institutional Banking team in the Isle of Man. This role focuses on understanding customer needs and helping the team identify and deliver product and service opportunities. You’ll carry out customer research and financial analysis and help shape high-quality materials for customer meetings. You’ll also coordinate day-to-day activity across client planning and pipeline management while keeping key data and call reports accurate and up to date. Alongside commercial support, the role plays an important part in ongoing risk monitoring across Global Standards and Anti-Money Laundering & Sanctions alerts. Success means better client engagement, strong operational execution and consistent adherence to regulatory, financial and legal standards.

The role requires experience in financial services, ideally within a commercial bank or financial institution, alongside strong analytical and financial skills to support sound decision-making. You’ll need to understand customer needs, deliver excellent service, and produce clear proposals, presentations and written communications tailored to different audiences. The position also involves managing competing priorities and deadlines, collaborating effectively with colleagues, and demonstrating an interest in developing towards managing a small portfolio of customers.

To Apply: https://portal.careers.hsbc.com/careers/job/563774612430398

Notes
Our client seeks an experienced and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join their team. This role focuses on maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day transactions, and ensuring compliance across a group of trading companies. Reporting directly to the Accounts Manager the successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the finance function, delivering timely reconciliations, and enabling informed decision-making. Key Responsibilities: Maintain accurate financial records for three active trading companies, ensuring all entries are complete and compliant with internal policies and relevant accounting standards. Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations, resolving discrepancies promptly. Process accounts payable and receivable, ensuring timely supplier payments and accurate client invoicing. Prepare and post journals for accruals, prepayments, and other adjustments. Manage intercompany transactions, reconciliations, and currency transfers. Support month-end and year-end close processes, including the preparation of management accounts and reports for the Financial Director. Assist with VAT and other statutory filings, liaising with external advisors as necessary. Monitor cash flow and provide forecasts to support operational planning. Maintain organised digital and physical financial documentation. Support internal and external audit requirements by providing accurate records and explanations. Key Skills and Experience: CAT qualified (or equivalent) or working towards a recognised accounting qualification, with potential support for ACCA study if desired. Proven accounting experience, ideally across multiple trading companies or group structures. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, reconciliations, and financial reporting. Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively across teams and with external partners. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16836

Our client seeks a Part-Time - Accountant to join their team. (Between 25 to 30 hours per week - Flexible) Role Profile Forming part of an experienced team at a small Office, the successful applicant will take day to day responsibility for a number of companies and trusts and various reporting processes, in addition to the compilation of management accounts on a quarterly basis. Preparation of annual financial statements may also be required, however guidance in this area will be provided where necessary. Key Responsibilities. The primary objective of the role will be to work within the accounting team to ensure the requisite accounting and administrative processes are completed for a small number of companies and trusts. Processing of payments and liaising with banks accordingly. Bank reconciliations. Investment reconciliations and liaising with banks/asset managers accordingly. Processing of day to day transactional accounting entries. Processing of month/quarter end accounting journals. Processing bespoke daily and weekly reporting such as investment reports. Preparation of month/quarter end management accounts. Preparation of annual financial statements. Assisting with external audit queries. Preparation of Isle of Man corporation tax returns. Other relevant projects from time to time as required. Provide cover for other members of the team during times of holiday and illness. Key Skills and Experience have experience of day to day journal entries, bank reconciliations, payments, accruals, prepayments, supplier control accounts. have experience in the preparation of management accounts and financial statements for Isle of Man Companies. Knowledge of the Paxus fund accounting system (primary accounting system used) and Sage accounts would be an advantage, but not essential as training will be provided. The successful candidate will be joining a small team supported by the Directors. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16808

As a Client Accountant, you will act as a key point of contact for your clients and play a central role in coordinating internal and external stakeholders. Working with the Captive Insurance Team to prepare monthly or quarterly management accounts including commentary and preparing semi-annual or annual regulatory returns. Contributing to the development of financial systems and processes. Participating in regulatory and accounting standards driven projects as required from time to time. Key Skills and Experience. Ability to work in a fast-paced, professional environment and takes pride in delivering excellent client service. Essential skills and experience. Professionally qualified (or time-served for the right candidate). Day-to-day, first-hand experience of producing management and statutory accounts. Working to client and regulatory driven deadlines and organising various stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Desirable (but not essential). Experience in insurance, captives, or risk management. Experience working in a regulated or professional services environment. Exposure to Board or senior management reporting.

Why HSBC
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
As an HSBC employee in the Channel Islands and Isle of Man (CIIOM) you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all employees, enhanced parental and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a non-contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.
The Opportunity
HSBC Channel Islands and Isle of Man (CIIOM) is seeking a Relationship Support Analyst to support Relationship Directors within our Corporate & Institutional Banking team in the Isle of Man. This role focuses on understanding customer needs and helping the team identify and deliver product and service opportunities. You’ll carry out customer research and financial analysis and help shape high-quality materials for customer meetings. You’ll also coordinate day-to-day activity across client planning and pipeline management while keeping key data and call reports accurate and up to date. Alongside commercial support, the role plays an important part in ongoing risk monitoring across Global Standards and Anti-Money Laundering & Sanctions alerts. Success means better client engagement, strong operational execution and consistent adherence to regulatory, financial and legal standards.

The role requires experience in financial services, ideally within a commercial bank or financial institution, alongside strong analytical and financial skills to support sound decision-making. You’ll need to understand customer needs, deliver excellent service, and produce clear proposals, presentations and written communications tailored to different audiences. The position also involves managing competing priorities and deadlines, collaborating effectively with colleagues, and demonstrating an interest in developing towards managing a small portfolio of customers.

To Apply: https://portal.careers.hsbc.com/careers/job/563774612430398

Our client seeks a Part Time Qualified Accountant to join their team (20 - 25 hours per week - Flexible) Role Profile: Forming part of an experienced team at a small Office, the successful applicant will take responsibility for the accounting function on a day to day basis, covering a number of companies and trusts and various reporting processes. Given the nature of the business, being a small team, the role will also at times involve providing holiday cover for other team members and therefore there is a requirement for the applicant to be flexible in their approach to job responsibilities. Experience and competence in the preparation and review of management accounts and financial statements (FRS 102A) is crucial. Key Skills and Experience: A qualified accountant (ACCA/ACA), preferably 'big four' trained (desirable). Have a minimum of 2 years PQE. Have management accounting experience including day to day transactional responsibility for operational companies and the preparation of management accounts and financial statements for such companies (prepared under UK GAAP, typically FRS 102A). Have substantial experience in the review of various reporting, including bespoke financial reporting, management accounts and financial statement prepared by junior members of the team. Knowledge of the Paxus fund accounting system (primary accounting system used) and Sage accounts would be an advantage, but not essential as training will be provided. Strong MS Excel capability is highly preferable. Experience working with MS PowerBI (or a similar reporting tool) is preferable but not essential. Excellent Benefits package: Competitive salary. Life cover/death in service. Private healthcare cover. Paid CPD and relevant Professional Subscriptions. If relevant, study support for professional qualifications. 25 days holiday (pro rata), increasing to 28 days (pro rata) after 5 years service. All Manx bank holidays. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16681

Role Purpose
The Senior Administrator is responsible for delivering an accurate, efficient and customer-focused investment administration service. The role involves managing transactions and complex queries, maintaining strong operational controls, supporting colleagues and contributing to continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
Investment Administration

Process investment transactions and customer requests accurately and within agreed service levels.

Maintain accurate investment, asset and customer records.

Liaise with fund managers, custodians, advisers and other counterparties to resolve queries and progress transactions.

Investigate complex issues, resolve outstanding transactions and escalate where necessary.

Follow established procedures, controls and regulatory requirements.

Customer and Stakeholder Management

Deliver a professional, timely and customer-focused service.

Take ownership of queries through to resolution.

Communicate clearly and work collaboratively with internal teams and external stakeholders.

Risk, Controls and Quality

Maintain high standards of accuracy and identify operational risks, errors and control weaknesses.

Complete quality checks and authorised activities where required.

Support investigations, corrective actions and accurate management reporting.

Team Support and Development

Provide technical guidance and support to colleagues.

Share knowledge, assist with training and contribute to workload planning.

Support the Team Leader or Manager with daily operations and wider team activities.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls and customer outcomes.

Support system changes, testing, procedure updates and business improvement initiatives.

Person Specification
Experience and Knowledge

Experience in financial services, ideally in investments, investment operations, life assurance or administration.

Good understanding of investment administration and operational processes.

Knowledge of funds, equities and bonds is desirable.

Experience handling complex queries, liaising with external parties and supporting colleagues is advantageous.

Skills and Behavior's

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Excellent organisation, prioritisation and problem-solving skills.

Clear written and verbal communication.

Ability to manage competing priorities and work under pressure.

Customer-focused, proactive and accountable approach.

Collaborative attitude with a willingness to support and develop colleagues.

Adaptability and commitment to continuous learning.

Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook and Word.

Our client seeks a Finance Assistant to join their team. This is a great opportunity for someone part-qualified (ACA/ACCA/CIMA) or newly qualified who wants to develop within a fast-moving, commercially focused finance function. You'll work closely with the Head of Finance, supporting management accounts production, month-end journals, variance analysis, and budgeting and forecasting across two product-focused business units. Key Responsibilities: Prepare and post month-end transaction-based journals relating to product-line activity. Support variance analysis and produce clear commentaries on management accounts and key financial information. Assist in the preparation and production of product profit and loss accounts, including monthly financial reports and ad hoc financial reporting requests. Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations for relevant general ledger codes. Prepare and validate purchase requests and check accounts payable expense invoices. Coordinate and help develop internal financial reports, maintaining the internal reporting control summary and ensuring timely delivery. Assist product managers in the preparation of monthly forecasts. Interact with cross-functional teams and the wider finance function to meet monthly deadlines and resolve accounting issues. Prepare and maintain process documentation; drive improvements to existing processes and controls. Support initiatives to improve product profits and profit margins. Assist in the processing and production of billing processes. Perform special projects and other duties as assigned. Key Skills and Experience: Experience in a similar financial or accounting role. Studying finalist for ACA, ACCA or CIMA, or newly qualified / qualified by experience. Strong analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities. Intermediate Excel skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a close-knit team. Familiarity with IoT, roaming, managed services, data centres or connectivity sectors is advantageous. Previous experience working with Sage X3 or a similar ERP system is desirable. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16908

About the role:

To work in the tax and accounting team which is responsible for the preparation of financial statements, tax returns and relevant submissions for a wide range of CSP clients alongside dealing with general practice clients in relation to personal and company tax compliance, tax advisory and financial statement preparation.

Reports to:  Associate Director - Tax. 

Main Responsibilities:

Assist in the preparation of financial statements, tax returns & submissions for CSP clients.
Maintaining company accounting records using sage and Xero.
Preparation of financial statements up to review stage with a view to progressing and becoming the reviewer.
Preparation of iXBRL financial Statements for submission to HMRC.
Preparation of company/individual and trust tax computations and tax returns for submission to both the Isle of Man tax office and HMRC.
Liaising with HMRC and the IOM Income Tax Office as necessary.
Liaising with clients.
Liaising with the various teams in the business to manage the various submission deadlines etc.

Essential skills:
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong attention to detail. 
Excellent organisational and time management skills. 
Be versatile and adaptable.   
Organized and able to meet deadlines .

Knowledge and qualifications:
Experience in preparation of financial statements.
Familiarity with FRS 102 and FRS 105.
Experience with IFRS is useful but not essential.
Experience of Isle of Man and UK tax would be advantageous, but training will be provided.
Ability to research legislation and draft detailed reports for review.
Attention to detail.

For more details and to apply contact epl.admin@epl.im or 01624615600.

About the role:
You will assist the Audit Manager in planning and executing audit processes, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial records. This role involves supporting the audit team, conducting audits, and helping to develop audit strategies.

Reports to: Associate Director – Audit  

Main Responsibilities:

Assist in planning, coordinating, and executing internal and external audits.
Support daily audit operations and ensure compliance with auditing standards.
Review and analyse financial statements, budgets, and forecasts.
Help ensure compliance with accounting principles, financial regulations, and company policies.
Assist in managing and mentoring the audit team.
Contribute to the development and implementation of audit strategies and procedures.
Identify and assess areas of financial risk and assist in implementing mitigation strategies.
Collaborate with external auditors and regulatory bodies.
Monitor audit findings and follow up on corrective actions.
There may be opportunities to work in other areas of the general practice and fiduciaries side of the business such as the preparation of financial statements and get involved with tax compliance such as drafting tax and VAT returns.

Essential skills:
Strong knowledge of auditing standards, accounting principles and financial reporting regulations.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
High attention to detail.

Knowledge and qualifications:
ACCA or ACA qualified or equivalent professional certification. 
Proficient in accounting software, Word, Excel and Outlook.

For more details and to apply contact epl.admin@epl.im or 01624615600.

Notes
We are seeking a qualified Sports Science & Health Analysis Specialist to join a developing health analysis and wellbeing centre on the Isle of Man. The role combines sports science, functional assessment, health and lifestyle analysis, performance and recovery support, and specialised technology-assisted analysis systems, working one-to-one with clients to conduct detailed assessments, interpret results and develop individualised programmes supporting wellbeing, recovery, performance, prevention and healthy ageing.
This specialist role requires strong scientific understanding of human physiology, movement, performance and recovery, combined with the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to clients. Responsibilities include conducting individual sports science and wellbeing assessments; operating the Centre's specialised analysis systems; interpreting assessment data; and explaining findings to clients. The successful candidate will develop individualised programmes relating to movement, activity, recovery, performance and lifestyle, provide guidance on performance, regeneration and recovery, and support prevention and healthy-ageing strategies, along with lifestyle, nutrition and supplement guidance where appropriate. The role also involves monitoring client progress, maintaining accurate confidential records, and developing assessment protocols and quality standards. Ongoing equipment training, continuing professional development and liaison with manufacturers and technical support teams form part of the position, alongside collaborative working with other health professionals and ensuring services remain within the Centre's non-medical scope, referring clients to medical professionals where necessary.
Applicants should hold a university degree in Sports Science or a closely related discipline, with a strong academic understanding of physiology, exercise physiology, movement and recovery. Experience in individual client assessment, consultation or programme development is essential, along with the ability to translate findings into practical recommendations. Strong analytical, interpersonal and communication skills are required, as is the ability to work independently, maintain accurate professional records, and communicate professionally in English. A willingness to undertake continuing professional development is expected. German language skills at B2 level or higher are essential, as certain specialist equipment is supplied by German manufacturers and related training and technical instruction may be delivered in German.
Experience in functional health, wellbeing, prevention, rehabilitation or healthy-ageing programmes would be advantageous, as would experience with athletes or physically active clients, technology-assisted assessment systems, and knowledge of nutrition and lifestyle factors affecting wellbeing. Knowledge of Vitalfeld technology and Non-Linear Systems would also be beneficial, along with experience developing assessment protocols or quality-management procedures and an interest in integrative approaches to health and longevity.
The role is based on the Isle of Man and centres on individual client consultations, requiring professionalism, confidentiality and attention to detail. Specialist training may be delivered outside the Isle of Man, requiring occasional international travel. As the Centre develops, the successful candidate may also contribute to new programmes and services. Appointment is subject to satisfactory evidence of qualifications, experience and legal entitlement to work on the Isle of Man.
Apply now by sending your CV to quantumanalysiscentrelimited@gmail.com

Responsibilities include conducting individual sports science and wellbeing assessments; operating the Centre's specialised analysis systems; interpreting assessment data; and explaining findings to clients. The successful candidate will develop individualised programmes relating to movement, activity, recovery, performance and lifestyle, provide guidance on performance, regeneration and recovery, and support prevention and healthy-ageing strategies, along with lifestyle, nutrition and supplement guidance where appropriate. The role also involves monitoring client progress, maintaining accurate confidential records, and developing assessment protocols and quality standards. Ongoing equipment training, continuing professional development and liaison with manufacturers and technical support teams form part of the position, alongside collaborative working with other health professionals and ensuring services remain within the Centre's non-medical scope, referring clients to medical professionals where necessary.
Applicants should hold a university degree in Sports Science or a closely related discipline, with a strong academic understanding of physiology, exercise physiology, movement and recovery. Experience in individual client assessment, consultation or programme development is essential, along with the ability to translate findings into practical recommendations. Strong analytical, interpersonal and communication skills are required, as is the ability to work independently, maintain accurate professional records, and communicate professionally in English. A willingness to undertake continuing professional development is expected. German language skills at B2 level or higher are essential, as certain specialist equipment is supplied by German manufacturers and related training and technical instruction may be delivered in German.
Experience in functional health, wellbeing, prevention, rehabilitation or healthy-ageing programmes would be advantageous, as would experience with athletes or physically active clients, technology-assisted assessment systems, and knowledge of nutrition and lifestyle factors affecting wellbeing. Knowledge of Vitalfeld technology and Non-Linear Systems would also be beneficial, along with experience developing assessment protocols or quality-management procedures and an interest in integrative approaches to health and longevity.
The role is based on the Isle of Man and centres on individual client consultations, requiring professionalism, confidentiality and attention to detail. Specialist training may be delivered outside the Isle of Man, requiring occasional international travel. As the Centre develops, the successful candidate may also contribute to new programmes and services. Appointment is subject to satisfactory evidence of qualifications, experience and legal entitlement to work on the Isle of Man.
Apply now by sending your CV to quantumanalysiscentrelimited@gmail.com

Karsons Pharmacy is looking for a reliable and enthusiastic Pharmacy Dispenser to join our friendly community pharmacy team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with at least 2 years' experience working in a community pharmacy who is passionate about delivering safe, accurate and efficient patient care. The role offers a varied workload, supporting the dispensary, assisting patients and customers, and occasionally undertaking pharmacy-related deliveries and collections.
Main Duties
Accurately prepare and dispense prescriptions under the supervision of the Pharmacist, provide excellent customer service, assist with prescription queries, maintain stock levels and inventory, receive and process deliveries, support the day-to-day operation of the dispensary, and carry out pharmacy deliveries or collections when required.
Essential Requirements
Minimum 2 years' experience working in a community pharmacy dispensary, a recognised dispensing qualification (or equivalent), experience using pharmacy dispensing systems, knowledge of NHS community pharmacy services, excellent attention to detail, strong customer service and communication skills, possess basic to intermediate computer literacy, the ability to work efficiently in a busy team environment, and a full, valid driving licence with the ability to drive as part of the role.
What We Offer
Competitive salary dependent on experience, a supportive and friendly working environment, ongoing training and professional development, the opportunity to work within a growing independent community pharmacy, and a varied role where you can make a real difference to patient care every day.
How to Apply
Please submit your CV together with a covering letter outlining your relevant pharmacy experience and telling us what professional value or principle guides the way you care for patients and work with others. Email your application to jobs@karsonspharmacy.co.uk.

Join our friendly team at Ellan Vannin Chiropractic Clinic!

Are you a qualified massage therapist who loves helping people feel their best? Are you reliable, enthusiastic and someone who enjoys being part of a supportive team?

We’re looking for a warm, professional and motivated massage therapist to join our busy chiropractic clinic.

Our ideal candidate is passionate about patient care, committed to ongoing professional development and, most importantly, a genuine team player who enjoys working alongside other healthcare professionals.

Experience in Swedish massage, deep tissue massage, pregnancy massage, sports massage or rehabilitation would be an advantage, although we’re happy to consider therapists with different specialisms.

Join our friendly team at Ellan Vannin Chiropractic Clinic!

Are you a qualified massage therapist who loves helping people feel their best? Are you reliable, enthusiastic and someone who enjoys being part of a supportive team?

We’re looking for a warm, professional and motivated massage therapist to join our busy chiropractic clinic.

Our ideal candidate is passionate about patient care, committed to ongoing professional development and, most importantly, a genuine team player who enjoys working alongside other healthcare professionals.

Experience in Swedish massage, deep tissue massage, pregnancy massage, sports massage or rehabilitation would be an advantage, although we’re happy to consider therapists with different specialisms.

Working hours: Initially Tuesday and Saturday mornings, with the potential for additional shifts as the role develops.

We offer a welcoming clinic environment, a supportive team, an established patient base and the opportunity to develop your skills within a multidisciplinary healthcare setting.

Both employed and self-employed arrangements may be considered.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we’d love to hear from you! Please send your CV and a short covering letter to Claire explaining your experience, what you enjoy most about being a massage therapist and why you feel you’d be a great fit for our team to reception@evchiropractic.co.uk.

Notes
The Community Support Worker is responsible for providing high-quality person-centred care and support to service users in their own homes. This role involves assisting service users with personal care, daily living activities, and promoting their independence and well-being. The Community Support Worker will work closely with service users, their families, and other care professionals to deliver personalised care services.

Key Responsibilities:
To assist service users with personal care tasks such as bathing, dressing and continence care. Support with mobility, including the use of aids and adaptations as required. Ensure that service users’ dignity and privacy are always maintained during personal care activities. Administer medication to service users according to their care plans and in line with company policies and procedures. Assist service users with meal preparation and hydration, ensuring that dietary needs are met.

You may be asked to help service users with light household tasks such as cleaning, laundry, and shopping, as needed. Accompany service users to appointments, social activities, and other outings to promote their social well-being. Encourage service users to engage in activities that promote their physical, emotional, and mental well-being. 

Foster a supportive environment that enables service users to achieve their goals and maintain their independence. Provide emotional support and companionship to service users. Observe and report any changes in service users’ physical or mental health to the Care Coordinator or Care Manager. Facilitate clear and effective communication between care staff, service users, and other professionals.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of care provided, including daily logs and incident reports. Ensure that any concerns regarding service users’ safety or well-being are promptly communicated and documented. Participate in ongoing training and development to maintain and enhance your skills and knowledge. Stay up to date with best practices in domiciliary care and any relevant legislative changes.

We support opportunities for personal and professional growth within the role. No previous experience required as full training will be provided and you must have the ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

Key Skills and Attributes:
Compassionate and caring nature with a strong commitment to supporting vulnerable individuals. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
Ability to work flexibly and respond to changing needs. 
Physical ability to assist clients with mobility and personal care tasks. 
Respect for diversity and cultural differences.

Additional Requirements:
Satisfactory enhanced DBS check.
Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and bank holidays.

Working Hours: Monday to Friday mornings and alternate weekends.

For more details and to apply contact office@ablecare.im or 01624 897813.

This role involves assisting service users with personal care, daily living activities, and promoting their independence and well-being. The Community Support Worker will work closely with service users, their families, and other care professionals to deliver personalised care services.

Key Responsibilities:
To assist service users with personal care tasks such as bathing, dressing and continence care. Support with mobility, including the use of aids and adaptations as required. Ensure that service users’ dignity and privacy are always maintained during personal care activities. Administer medication to service users according to their care plans and in line with company policies and procedures. Assist service users with meal preparation and hydration, ensuring that dietary needs are met.

You may be asked to help service users with light household tasks such as cleaning, laundry, and shopping, as needed. Accompany service users to appointments, social activities, and other outings to promote their social well-being. Encourage service users to engage in activities that promote their physical, emotional, and mental well-being. 

Foster a supportive environment that enables service users to achieve their goals and maintain their independence. Provide emotional support and companionship to service users. Observe and report any changes in service users’ physical or mental health to the Care Coordinator or Care Manager. Facilitate clear and effective communication between care staff, service users, and other professionals.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of care provided, including daily logs and incident reports. Ensure that any concerns regarding service users’ safety or well-being are promptly communicated and documented. Participate in ongoing training and development to maintain and enhance your skills and knowledge. Stay up to date with best practices in domiciliary care and any relevant legislative changes.

We support opportunities for personal and professional growth within the role. No previous experience required as full training will be provided and you must have the ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

Key Skills and Attributes:
Compassionate and caring nature with a strong commitment to supporting vulnerable individuals. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
Ability to work flexibly and respond to changing needs. 
Physical ability to assist clients with mobility and personal care tasks. 
Respect for diversity and cultural differences.

Additional Requirements:
Satisfactory enhanced DBS check.
Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and bank holidays.

Working Hours: Monday to Friday mornings and alternate weekends.

For more details and to apply contact office@ablecare.im or 01624 897813.

We are seeking friendly and resilient Additional Support Workers to join us across all our services. We have over 9 different houses located both in Eastern and Central parts of the Island where they are located within easy reach of local bus routes. You will be joining a friendly, established team that provides quality support to autistic adults.

We are looking for people who will bring their passion and enthusiasm to the role. Autism Initiatives provide specialist support for people with autism and we are committed to working in partnership to achieve the best possible outcomes.

As an Additional Support Worker you will support with a range of activities which meet the wishes of the people that we support and encourages people with autism to live as independently as possible and be part of their local community. Activities could include: swimming, accessing day trips, gardening, walking groups and many more.

The role of an Additional Support Worker enables you to accept shifts around your availability and other commitments. If you are looking for some variety, flexibility in hours and are keen to make a difference, please get in touch today!

This is a truly rewarding role, with the opportunity for you to develop your skills and knowledge and fulfil your career aspirations.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

For more information, or to apply, please visit jobs.autisminitiatives.org.

Notes
Align 4 Life is a state-of-the-art family chiropractic, spine and posture clinic, dedicated to helping people of all ages improve their health, wellbeing and quality of life.

We're looking for an enthusiastic, organised and personable Head of Clinic Administration to play a key role in our growing team. We need someone who is reliable, energetic, highly organised and people-focused, with excellent communication skills and attention to detail.
Previous administration experience is essential, with team leadership or supervisory experience advantageous. Confidence with computers and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace is required. Experience in corporate, hospitality or customer-focused environments is beneficial.
This is a varied and fast-paced position for someone who enjoys working with people and is confident taking responsibility for leading the administrative operation while supporting front-of-house and the wider clinic team.
Key Responsibilities: 
Lead the day-to-day administration and organisation of the clinic; manage patient appointments, diaries, enquiries and correspondence; maintain accurate records, databases, stats and documentation; support management and the HR team; help manage supplies, equipment and office organisation; support front desk to welcome patients and visitors and provide an exceptional experience; answer calls and emails professionally; support the wider clinic team and help improve operational efficiency.
What We Offer:
Full 4-week initial training, free chiropractic care, ongoing training and personal development, career growth opportunities, staff incentives and competitions, a positive, energetic working environment and the opportunity to work in a Chiropractic Biophysics clinic — one of only five in the UK.

Apply with your CV and covering letter to neil@align4life.com 
Please also phone and leave a brief message (30 secs only) as to why you think you would be a great asset to the Align 4 Life team on the following number:
01624 678598 
(N.B. Emailed applications will only be considered if a phone message is also left.)

Head Chef

We’re looking for an experienced and passionate Head Chef to lead a busy hospitality kitchen, delivering consistently great food while creating a positive, well-organised environment for the team.

You’ll take ownership of the day-to-day kitchen operation, including food quality and presentation, team leadership and development, stock and ordering, food costs and wastage, menu development, and maintaining excellent standards of food safety, hygiene and kitchen compliance.

You’ll ideally have previous experience as a Head Chef, Kitchen Manager or experienced Sous Chef, together with a recognised professional cookery qualification such as NVQ Level 2/3, City & Guilds or equivalent, although substantial industry experience will also be considered.

A recognised Food Safety/Food Hygiene qualification is required, along with a good working knowledge of HACCP, allergen management and kitchen health & safety. You’ll also be confident managing stock, controlling costs and leading and developing a kitchen team.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is hands-on, organised and passionate about great food, with the confidence to take ownership of their kitchen and lead from the front.

Whether you’re an established Head Chef or an experienced Sous Chef ready to take the next step, we’d love to hear from you.

Our stores are a fun, busy and fast­-paced environment. When the going gets tough, we all pitch in to get the job done together, without hesitation.
 
As a Domino’s Pizza In-Store Team Member, within our Ramsey store, you will have the opportunity to jump into the hospitality sector and deliver top-quality products to our customers. You will be involved in taking orders, pizza-making and working within a small, hard-working team, whilst following set policies and procedures, to help the team members on your shift to produce great food and ensure complete customer satisfaction.

We also have great career progression within our organisation.
 
Successful candidates will have: flexibility with your working hours as our stores are predominantly busy in the evenings and on weekends; excellent people skills; good written and verbal communication; high levels of problem ­solving, initiative and self motivation; a willingness to learn and a drive to succeed; passion for providing excellent customer service; and the ability to work as part of a team.

The rate of pay ranges from £11.50ph to £13.50ph, depending on age, plus you receive an addiitonal £1ph for all weekend hours worked.
 
As well as the competitive pay structure, benefits include 4 weeks holiday per annum, employee discounts and a flexible schedule.
 
Both full-time and part-time applicants will be considered.

If you would like to join the team, please submit your CV to iomdominos@gmail.com

Store Team Roles - Baristas: We're Costa, the nation's favourite coffee shop brand, pouring our heart and soul into everything we do and creating moments to remember for our customers, our communities and for each other. Together we turn sips into smiles, choices into opportunities and passions into careers. Help us spread a little happiness. 

About the role – Barista: As a Barista, naturally you'll be serving expertly crafted coffee, but at Costa there's more to the role than that. 
You'll be creating moments that linger and experiences that last. It takes a little crafting, testing and fine-tuning to get it spot on, but with your zest for life, flexible approach and ability to read our customers, you'll soon find yourself delivering coffee experiences that are simply unbeatable. 
The right candidate must be Barista trained and have knowledge of Costa and its brand standards. 

What we Offer You: 
Free Parking
Free meals
Free Uniform
‘Employee Assistance Programme’ provided to all employees
Wage enhancement for working between 05.30-07.30am - an extra £2 per hour. 
Please apply in writing and include a CV, and email it to iomcosta@caterleisure.co.uk 

Vacancies will be advertised for 1 month. If you do not hear from us after 1 month, please assume your application has been unsuccessful

As a Commis Chef, you will act as the foundational support for our kitchen operations. You will be responsible for preparing ingredients, assisting across various stations, and maintaining our high standards of kitchen cleanliness and food safety while developing your culinary skills. Assisting senior chefs with daily food preparation, including washing, peeling, chopping, and portioning ingredients. Supporting the hot and cold lines during service by helping with basic cooking, assembly, and precise plating. Receiving, inspecting, organising, and rotating stock deliveries in accordance with food storage guidelines. Maintaining a clean, sanitary, and safe workstation throughout the shift and completing deep-cleaning tasks at close. Adhering strictly to health, hygiene, and safety regulations at all times. Prior experience working in a professional kitchen environment or a relevant culinary qualification. Basic knowledge of food safety principles and kitchen hygiene. The ability to stand for long periods and thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. A strong work ethic, punctuality, and a genuine eagerness to learn and grow within the culinary team.

For more details and to apply contact smashnfry@gmail.com

We have rebranded and continue to grow to the needs of our customers. We’re looking for someone outgoing, pleasant, and passionate about serving great breakfast, sandwiches and homecooked food. Serving delicious Hot home cooked foods like lasagne to beef stews, Sausage baps and serving amazing fresh salad boxes, wraps and baguettes on our Deli counter.

A friendly, approachable personality.
The ability to multitask while staying calm under pressure. 
Be able to start work at 7am. 

Hours: 42 per week (including a Saturday once a month).
Applicants must be 21+.
Good Pay and free breakfast and lunch. 

To apply, send your CV & experience to newsbeat@outlook.com  or privately to saxman_6@hotmail.com

We can’t wait to meet you!

Job Title:     Costa Assistant Manager
Vacancies:  1
Hours: 	     39hrs per week 
Salary:         £14 per hour
Contact:      Chanelle Davey
Tel No.         01624 823538
Email:           iomcosta@caterleisure.co.uk 

We're Costa, the nation's favourite coffee shop brand, pouring our heart and soul into everything we do and creating moments to remember for our customers, our communities and for each other. Together we turn sips into smiles, choices into opportunities and passions into careers. Help us spread a little happiness.

Store Team Role - Assistant Manager
As the Assistant Manager you will assist the Manager in all aspects of the job. You need to be commercially aware, with the presence and personality to influence the day-to-day business. Along with delivering excellent customer service, you will be expected to lead by example, setting high standards, driving sales and controlling profits. We will expect you to provide a high level of customer service whilst maintaining health and hygiene at all times. You are required to be energetic, enthusiastic, responsible, trustworthy, hardworking and reliable.

Responsibilities
Daily running of the unit.
Organising staff shifts.
Ensuring that all members of your team are trained in food / drink preparation, and comply with all aspects of our Health and Safety and Food Safety Policies

Safety policies.
Ensure all company and unit reports are completed efficiently.
Company merchandising and standards are adhered to ensuring a consistently high level of store standards are maintained.
Stock procedures are managed and controlled within agreed targets and policies to ensure minimal wastage.
Liaise with clients and suppliers on a regular basis to ensure a constant offering of food and beverages of a high quality.
Communication with your team (and the overall company) recognising the importance of managing staff morale, ensuring all staff are continually developed using the company's training programme.
Experience and Qualifications
Previous experience of working within a customer facing environment.
Supervisory experience.
Enthusiasm to execute outstanding customer service.
Positive attitude with willingness.
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively with customers, clients, and staff at all levels.
Ability to achieve and set standards and operate to performance criteria, with particular regard to hygiene.
Ability to work effectively as part of a team desirable:
Previous experience within a coffee environment.
Ideal candidate must drive and be able to arrive at the airport for shifts commencing at 5 a.m. 

What we Offer You: 
Free Parking.
Free meals.
Free Uniforms.
‘Employee Assistance Programme’ provided to all employees.

Please apply in writing and include a CV, and email it to iomcosta@caterleisure.co.uk

Tel: 01624 823538
Vacancies will be advertised for 1 month. If you do not hear from us after 1 month, please assume your application has been unsuccessful

We are looking for an experienced, passionate and hands-on Head Chef to lead our kitchen at Padel Park Eatery, located in Nobles Park, Douglas, alongside Manx Padel, the Island's first dedicated padel club. We currently serve breakfast, brunch and lunch, with plans to expand into evening dining and additional events as the business grows.

The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the daily running of the kitchen, preparing and delivering high-quality meals, maintaining consistency in food quality and presentation, and developing creative menus, seasonal specials and new dishes. Responsibilities will include leading, training and supervising kitchen staff, managing food preparation and service, ordering and stock control, supplier relationships, food costing, portion control and minimising waste. The Head Chef will also ensure compliance with food hygiene, allergen management, health and safety standards, and work closely with management to develop future evening dining menus and support catering for tournaments, private functions and events.

Applicants must have a minimum of 5 years' professional chef experience in a commercial kitchen, with previous experience as a Head Chef, Sous Chef or senior chef with kitchen leadership responsibilities. Strong culinary skills, menu development experience, kitchen management abilities and a sound understanding of food safety are essential. We are looking for someone who is organised, reliable, creative and confident leading a kitchen team, with the ability to maintain high standards during busy service periods. Flexibility to work weekends and future evening shifts is required.
To apply, please email your CV and details of your relevant professional chef experience to angela@manxpadel.com.

At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. It's about perfecting latte art, creating experiences that put a smile on people's faces, and proudly making greatness every day. 

We’re passionate about being a great place to work with our Sea Terminal store, where you can bring your real self into our mix.    Making our drinks with heart, giving our customers a warm welcome and a lasting impression so they come back to our stores and enjoy an exceptional experience. 

What you’ll do.  Being a Barista means so much more than making velvety cups of joy. It’s your chance to learn, challenge yourself and truly master your craft the Costa Way - which means you’ll be: Putting smiles on faces come rain or shine; Mastering our menu, from toasties to seasonal drinks and more; Pouring passion into perfect drinks and great customer service; Keeping your store clean, tidy and welcoming; Working with your colleagues to make our stores the very best. 

Who you are?   You will be a Barista with at least 2 years experience who has mastered the bar or have worked for at least 2 years in a similar hospitality environment.  You will be ambitious, love to lead by example to create a collaborative team culture and are ready for the next step to be mentored for progression from Barista to Shift Leader and Assistant Manager.  

We’re interested in your unique ingredients:  A multi-tasker with a can-do attitude; not afraid to take on a challenge; A perfectionist, dedicated to delivering excellence; A people person and a team player, who can strike up a good conversation, lead and inspire to drive exceptional performance to exceed our Key Performance Indicators.   You will be passionate about hospitality and creating great guest experiences.    

What we can offer: We’re really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded.   Our starting rate is £12.86 p/h, increasing upon progression from Barista to Shift leader and Assistant Manager.   Free hot and cold drinks on shift, plus discount on food and bottled drinks. 20 days paid holiday increasing to 25 days, Recognition and performance related rewards.
