Barista Costa Coffee Sea Terminal,  ready for the next level?

At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. It's about perfecting latte art, creating experiences that put a smile on people's faces, and proudly making greatness every day. 

We’re passionate about being a great place to work with our Sea Terminal store, where you can bring your real self into our mix.    Making our drinks with heart, giving our customers a warm welcome and a lasting impression so they come back to our stores and enjoy an exceptional experience. 

What you’ll do.  Being a Barista means so much more than making velvety cups of joy. It’s your chance to learn, challenge yourself and truly master your craft the Costa Way - which means you’ll be: Putting smiles on faces come rain or shine; Mastering our menu, from toasties to seasonal drinks and more; Pouring passion into perfect drinks and great customer service; Keeping your store clean, tidy and welcoming; Working with your colleagues to make our stores the very best. 

Who you are?   You will be a Barista with at least 2 years experience who has mastered the bar or have worked for at least 2 years in a similar hospitality environment.  You will be ambitious, love to lead by example to create a collaborative team culture and are ready for the next step to be mentored for progression from Barista to Shift Leader and Assistant Manager.  

We’re interested in your unique ingredients:  A multi-tasker with a can-do attitude; not afraid to take on a challenge; A perfectionist, dedicated to delivering excellence; A people person and a team player, who can strike up a good conversation, lead and inspire to drive exceptional performance to exceed our Key Performance Indicators.   You will be passionate about hospitality and creating great guest experiences.    

What we can offer: We’re really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded.   Our starting rate is £12.86 p/h, increasing upon progression from Barista to Shift leader and Assistant Manager.   Free hot and cold drinks on shift, plus discount on food and bottled drinks. 20 days paid holiday increasing to 25 days, Recognition and performance related rewards. 

Please email your CV and covering letter outlining why you wish to become part of the Costa Team to hrteam@fancyacoffee.im

Events Coordinator:
Comis Hotel & Golf Resort | Santon, Isle of Man.
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience.
Hours: 40 hours per week, with flexibility to work evenings, weekends and bank holidays as required.
We are looking for an enthusiastic and organised Events Coordinator to join our Food & Beverage team at Comis Hotel & Golf Resort.
You will coordinate weddings, corporate events and special occasions, working closely with clients and hotel departments to deliver exceptional experiences at our four-star resort.
Key Responsibilities:
Plan and coordinate events from initial enquiry through to completion.
Liaise with clients, suppliers and internal departments to ensure successful event delivery.
Prepare event plans, schedules, budgets and relevant documentation.
Oversee event setup and delivery, resolving any issues promptly.
Maintain accurate booking records, contracts and client communications.
Support invoicing, payment tracking and post-event reporting.
About You:
Previous experience in event planning, coordination or a similar hospitality role.
Excellent organisational, communication and customer service skills.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple events and deadlines.
Commercial awareness and confidence working with clients and suppliers.
Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience using event management software is advantageous.
Flexible to work evenings, weekends and bank holidays according to event schedules.
What We Offer:
Competitive salary, service charge participation, staff meals and uniform, hotel discounts, employee recognition schemes, free on-site parking and career development opportunities.
How to Apply:
Please send your CV to HR@comishotel.com.
Applicants must have the legal right to work in the Isle of Man and any necessary work permit.
STRICTLY NO AGENCIES

https://apogeecorp.ciphr-irecruit.com/applicants/vacancy/818/1st-Line-Support-Technician

JOB DETAILS

As a 1st Line Helpdesk Technician, you will be the first point of contact for customers needing support with IT, hardware, software and network-related issues.

You will handle incoming support requests, diagnose problems, provide remote support where possible, and escalate more complex issues to the right team when needed. This is a customer-focused role, so keeping clients updated and delivering a helpful, professional service is key.

The role will involve:

Responding to customer support requests by phone, email or ticketing system.
Logging, managing and updating support tickets accurately.
Providing first-line troubleshooting for laptops, desktops, applications, servers and network issues.
Using remote access tools to investigate and resolve IT faults.
Keeping customers informed on progress and agreed next steps.
Escalating issues where they cannot be resolved at first point of contact.
Supporting service levels by responding to issues promptly and professionally.
A typical working pattern is Monday to Friday, 08:30 to 17:30, with a one-hour lunch break. This role also offers flexibility to work from home, typically two days per week for a five-day working week once training is complete.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Experience supporting customers with IT, hardware or software issues.
Good understanding of laptops, desktops, basic networking and common IT applications.
Confident troubleshooting skills across Windows PCs, Macs, printers or connected devices.
Knowledge of basic network terms such as IP addressing, DNS and routing.
Experience using remote support or ticketing tools would be useful.
Ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.
A practical approach to problem solving and knowing when to escalate issues.
We value candidates with AI literacy – individuals who are curious about technology, comfortable exploring automation, and eager to contribute to a modern, forward-thinking business.

Our client seeks a Risk & Governance Analyst to be responsible for supporting the effective operation of the Technology & Change risk and governance framework. The role ensures that risk, control, policy, audit, outsourcing and regulatory activities are coordinated, monitored and reported in a timely and consistent manner. Working closely with Technology leadership, risk owners and key stakeholders, the role helps maintain a strong control environment through the management of risk assessments, risk registers, policy reviews, supplier governance and audit activities, while supporting compliance with internal standards and regulatory requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Experience working within a risk, controls, Audit and/or governance role. Strong understanding of risk management and control frameworks, including risk assessments, root cause analysis (RCA), corrective and preventative actions, remediation planning, control monitoring and continuous improvement activities. Demonstrates initiative, accountability and a sense of ownership for delivering outcomes. Effective communicator with strong organisational and coordination skills, able to manage competing priorities and maintain attention to detail. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate risks, identify root causes, assess impacts and support effective practical solutions. Ability to produce prompt, accurate, clear and concise reporting. Experience performing GAP analysis identifying areas for improvement and supporting areas for remediation. Ability to work with senior managers, risk owners, auditors and suppliers. Experience using AI tools to support risk management, governance and control activities, while ensuring appropriate governance and responsible use of AI. Relevant Risk, Governance, Audit or IT certifications (ie IRM Certificate in Risk Management, ISO 27001 etc). Knowledge of the Financial Services. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16824

Our client seeks a Senior Protection Claims Assessor to join their Underwriting team. This is more than a traditional processing role. Alongside assessing protection claims, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to underwriting and claims governance activities, support process improvements, work closely with reinsurers and help shape the ongoing development of the underwriting and claims philosophies. Key Responsibilities: Assessing life and disability insurance claims and determining appropriate requirements and sign off in line with company philosophy. Reviewing complex and higher-risk cases, including referrals requiring advanced technical judgement. Analysing claims documents including medical, financial, occupational and lifestyle information to evaluate risk. Supporting underwriting governance activities, audits and quality assurance reviews. Coaching and mentoring colleagues to enhance technical knowledge and capability. Building effective relationships with reinsurers and other internal and external stakeholders. Supporting automation, system enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Skills and Experience: A minimum of 5 years' experience in life insurance underwriting and/or protection claims. Strong technical knowledge and decision-making ability. Experience assessing complex and higher-risk cases. A sound understanding of underwriting philosophy, risk management and reinsurance principles. Strong Microsoft Office skills and excellent planning and organisational abilities. Commercial awareness and excellent judgement. Professional qualifications such as ALU, ACII or Dip CII would be advantageous. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16886

The role offers broad exposure across risk and compliance and the opportunity to contribute to the continued development of risk management, regulatory compliance, and governance across the jurisdictions in which Monument International operates.  The role is primarily focused on the Isle of Man business; however, the role holder will also provide risk, compliance, and data protection support and oversight to the Singapore branch as required. 
 
Working within the Risk and Compliance function, the role holder will act as the principal day-to-day risk management resource to the CRO & IHoC, taking ownership of the coordination and delivery of agreed risk management activities under the CRO & IHoC’s direction.  The role holder will provide independent oversight, constructive challenge, monitoring, advice, and reporting across the Company’s risks and support the continued development and effective operation of the Risk Management Framework, helping to promote a strong risk culture across Monument International and its associated entities.

The role holder will also undertake compliance activities within the Compliance Framework and priorities established by the CRO & IHoC, working independently on allocated activities with day-to-day direction and functional oversight provided by the Compliance Manager.  The role holder will work with senior management and the wider business to maintain robust governance arrangements and regulatory compliance.
The role holder will also perform or assist with the responsibilities of the Isle of Man Data Protection Officer (DPO). To apply https://monument-re-insurance.jobs.personio.de/job/2833053

Notes
We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Promotions Strategy & Optimisation Manager to drive the performance of promotions, campaigns and bonuses across our Sportsbook and Casino products.
Key Responsibilities
Promotions & Performance Optimisation:
Lead the optimisation of promotions, campaigns and bonus activity across Sportsbook and Casino.  Analyse performance to understand which offers and mechanics are delivering against their objectives.  Identify inefficient or underperforming activity and recommend improvements to targeting, mechanics, rewards and timing.
Identify opportunities to scale or further improve successful promotions.   Define and monitor KPIs including promotional cost, participation, conversion, retention, engagement and player value.  Assess the incremental impact of promotional activity to understand the true value generated.  Establish a strong test-and-learn approach using A/B testing, control groups and experimentation.
Personalisation & Automation:
Work with CRM, BI, Product and other teams to improve promotional targeting and personalisation.  Identify opportunities to use player behaviour, preferences and value to determine the most relevant offer, reward and timing.  Support the development of automated promotional decision-making and personalised journeys.
Explore how predictive models and machine learning can improve promotional effectiveness.  Define success measures and continuously evaluate automated activity.
Innovation & Collaboration:
Keep up to date with developments in Sportsbook and Casino promotions, bonusing and player engagement.  Monitor competitor activity and identify new mechanics, capabilities and opportunities.  Bring new ideas to the Promotions team and challenge existing approaches where data suggests there is a better way.
Work closely with Promotions, CRM, BI and Product to turn insights into practical improvements.  The above duties provide a generic description of the Employee’s day to day responsibilities but should in no way be deemed to be an exhaustive list. Additional related, duties may be assigned by the Line Manager in line with business exigencies and continuity.
What We're Looking For:
Experience in promotions, bonusing, CRM, commercial analytics, player analytics or a related optimisation role.  Experience within Sportsbook, Casino, iGaming or a similar digital industry.  A highly analytical and data-driven mindset with strong commercial judgement.  Experience evaluating campaign or promotional performance against clear objectives.  A strong understanding of segmentation, targeting and personalisation.  Experience with experimentation and test-and-learn methodologies.
An understanding of how automation and machine learning can support marketing and promotional decision-making.  The ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.  Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

For more details and to apply contact talent@silverspin.com or 07624269891.

Notes
MayFly Entertainment is a licensed gambling operator regulated by the Isle of Man Gambling Supervision Commission (GSC). As Head of Commercial, you will be leading the company’s customer acquisition and commercial growth agenda across key markets, focusing on developing and executing effective acquisition strategies, strengthening and optimising affiliate and key account relationships, and managing marketing and sponsorship investments to deliver sustainable and profitable growth. You will combine strong commercial leadership, relationship management and analytical capabilities to maximise customer acquisition, improve conversion performance and ensure effective allocation of commercial resources. Key responsibilities include leading the company’s customer acquisition strategy across key markets, identifying growth opportunities, optimising acquisition channels and ensuring commercial activities deliver sustainable and profitable customer growth; developing and managing affiliate relationships through performance reviews, commercial negotiations, partner development and ongoing optimisation of affiliate investment and acquisition efficiency; building and maintaining strong relationships with key accounts and strategic commercial partners; owning the marketing and sponsorship budget and ensuring measurable returns on investment; driving improvements in customer conversion through collaboration with Product, Payments, Operations and Marketing teams; producing commercial performance reporting and monitoring key commercial KPIs; and attending industry conferences and networking events to identify new opportunities and maintain market awareness. Candidates should have experience in a similar commercial leadership role, ideally within online gaming, a degree in Business Management, Marketing or a related discipline, and proven expertise in customer acquisition, affiliate management, commercial relationship development, budget ownership, performance optimisation and commercial negotiations. A strong analytical mindset, the ability to interpret complex information and excellent relationship-building skills are essential. Our interviews are a two-way conversation, giving you the opportunity to get to know us as much as we get to know you, and we encourage questions and curiosity throughout the process. Early application is advised as this vacancy may close once sufficient applications have been received. To apply, please send your CV to recruitment@mayflyentertainment.com.

Notes
A family-owned business, we are passionate about our products and deliver a high-quality customer service to our international client base. 
We provide our clients with high-end quality timber flooring that uses cutting edge-technology and hand craftsmanship to create stunning long lasting products. We have implemented a sustainable approach to the sourcing, manufacturing and distribution of our products, offering a completely safe, green product that has a lesser impact on the environment than traditional timber flooring.

Due to our expanding operations, we are seeking an experienced General Manager to oversee a broad range of operational, sales, purchasing, and administrative functions. This role requires strong leadership, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to manage both day to day operations and long term objectives.
The General Manager will oversee the full customer order lifecycle, from initial enquiries through to quotes, purchase orders, sales invoices and shipping documents. You will ensure that all client communications are handled professionally and that responses are accurate and timely. This includes monitoring client and internal emails, resolving issues promptly, and preparing quotes and invoices once production details are confirmed. You will maintain accurate client profiles and product information, stay informed about sample and display products to support marketing activities, and coordinate the creation of specialised client documentation such as labelling, packaging instructions, installation guides, and compliance requirements.
In addition, you will manage all purchasing activities by reviewing and verifying order information, production schedules, and shipping arrangements. You will maintain daily production logs, prepare and process customer orders, and work closely with the factory to establish manufacturing lead times and container loading schedules. You will also issue purchase orders and monitor their progress to ensure deadlines are met, while maintaining clear communication with colleagues to support the accurate and timely fulfilment of client requests.
The role also includes responsibility for staff recruitment and training, supervising team members, and managing general office operations. Attendance at training sessions and trade shows, including overseas events, may be required.
Candidates must demonstrate English language proficiency, hold the legal right to work, and have advanced Excel skills. A minimum of ten years of experience in shipping and stock management is essential.
The successful candidate must have excellent organisational and time management skills and a strong attention to detail.

If you would like to know more information or would like to apply for this role, please send your CV with a covering letter to veena@ftholdingsltd.com

IOM resident and be able to attend board meetings in person .This is a purposeful boardroom environment where independent challenge is not just welcomed it is essential. If you are a credible, commercially aware and values-driven senior leader ready to make a meaningful contribution at board level, we want to hear from you. We’re looking for a Crew Operations Manager to lead day to day fleet operations and power the next chapter of our company’s growth. If you’ve built your craft at sea and want to amplify your leadership ashore, this is your chance to shape outcomes across safety, reliability, people, and performance, while growing your own leadership portfolio at pace.
The role requires sailing experience as a senior officer on LNG carriers, together with a thorough understanding of the shipping industry and tanker operations. Given the nature of the position, the successful candidate must have substantial strong solid expertise relevant to LNG and tanker vessels, including operational, safety, regulatory and commercial knowledge that can only be acquired through significant seagoing and fleet management experience.
Our fleet is expanding. We need an operations leader who understands ships, crews, ports, and most importantly, the realities of seagoing life, someone who can translate that insight into outstanding operational delivery and continuous improvement. You’ll help us deliver on our vision: the right people, in the right place, at the right time, at the right cost, every voyage, every time.
Lead end-to-end crew operations
Ensure safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-effective manning for the fleet. Oversee day-to-day crewing delivery across a diverse seafarer population, ensuring the right people are deployed to the right vessel at the right time. Apply practical operational knowledge of LNG and tanker operations to assess competence requirements, operational risks, and vessel-specific crewing needs.

Key Responsibilities
 Translate the group strategy and business plan into an executable operating plan for the Isle of Man and its extended trade offices (Monaco, Ghana and Senegal). Track delivery against agreed objectives.
 Lead and implement the commercial strategy in conjunction with the GPL’s and IOM commercial teams for the procurement, marketing, and distribution of agricultural commodities by identifying market opportunities, strengthening relationships with customers and strategic suppliers, and ensuring the competitiveness of the business.
 Ensure compliance with the budget, profitability (P&L), cash flow generation, and the efficient management of working capital, ensuring the financial sustainability of the region.
 Oversee the comprehensive management of commercial, financial, operational, and market risks, including exposure to price, foreign exchange, credit, and counterparty risks, ensuring compliance with corporate policies.

 Lead, develop, and strengthen a high-performing team, promoting a culture based on leadership, accountability, collaboration, innovation, talent development, and results orientation.
 Build and maintain clear performance dashboards and KPIs. Give the VP Supply Chain and group stakeholders accurate, timely insight on results, risks and opportunities.
 Present business results, key risks, opportunities, and strategic plans to the VP Supply Chain, ensuring informed decision-making.
 Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications & Experience
Essential
Minimum of 10 years of professional experience, including at least 4 years in senior leadership positions. A benefit of also having full responsibility for business results (P&L).
Industry experience in the trading of agricultural commodities, or agribusiness, or food, or raw materials, or related industries.
A demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams, and to be trusted by colleagues across functions.
Qualification in Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Finance, International Business, or related fields.
Preferred
Experience within a commodity trading, agricultural, or related multinational trading business
Proficiency in MS365 applications including Excel, Word, Teams, and SharePoint; experience with AI and large language model (LLM) tools is a further advantage
Experience operating within a Fortune 500 or publicly listed group reporting structure
Exposure to data warehouse integrations, BI reporting tools (e.g., Copilot, PowerBI), and automation solutions.

Home Help / Nanny–Housekeeper.
Part-Time or Full-Time (Term Time & School Holidays).
We are a busy family looking for a dependable, caring, and organised home help to support our household and care for our two daughters, aged 7 and 10.
We are open to either a part-time role focused on after-school care, or a full-time role combining childcare and household support during term time, with more childcare focus in school holidays.
Part-Time Role – After-School Care.
Responsibilities include:
Collecting our children from school.
Preparing and serving healthy, nutritious meals.
Taking the children to after-school clubs and activities (and getting their bags ready for the clubs).
Ensuring the children are safe, well cared for, and supported after school.
This role would suit someone looking for regular afternoon/evening hours during term time.
Full-Time Role – Nanny–Housekeeper.
Responsibilities include:
All after-school childcare duties listed above.
Helping to run the household on a day-to-day basis.
General housekeeping tasks such as tidying, laundry, shopping, meal preparation and keeping the home organised.
Supporting the smooth running of the household.
During school holidays, the role will place a greater emphasis on childcare, including caring for the children during the day and keeping them engaged and active.
Requirements (Both Roles).
A kind, responsible, and reliable nature.
Experience caring for children of a similar age (preferred).
Ability to prepare healthy meals.
A clean driving licence and use of your own car (Petrol money will be provided as part of the remuneration).
A clean, enhanced DBS check (or willingness to obtain one).
Organised, proactive, and trustworthy.
We Offer:
Choice of part-time or full-time employment.
A friendly family environment.
Competitive pay, depending on experience and hours.
If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we would love to hear from you. Call 07624206008

Our client seeks a TCSP Compliance Officer to join their team on a part-time basis. Subject to regulatory approval, and after adequate training and familiarisation, the role holder will ultimately hold the following statutory positions: Compliance Officer, under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book. Ideally, Money Laundering Reporting Officer, under the IOM AML/CFT Code 2019. You must be able to satisfy the IOM FSA on competence, time commitment, accessibility and effective oversight. An initial familiarisation period may be agreed before specific statutory positions are formally transferred. Key Responsibilities: Discharge the statutory Compliance Officer role under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book, acting as primary point of contact with the IOM FSA. Maintain compliance monitoring programme, regulatory returns, statutory registers, policy suite and the authorisation of new SPV structures. Oversee periodic client reviews and approve higher-risk new business across the SPV book. Ideally hold the MLRO function, receive internal reports, liaise with the IOM Financial Intelligence Unit. Run group sanctions screening (OFSI, OFAC, EU, UN), customer due diligence and transaction monitoring proportionate to the group's exposure, with particular attention to maritime risk. Deliver annual AML/CFT training to employees and report to the relevant boards on financial crime risk. Maintain the compliance requirements and risk assessment suite, AML/CFT and policy suite, and report to the Board. Key Skills and Experience: Ideally minimum three years' compliance experience in regulated financial services. Working knowledge of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book and AML/CFT Code 2019. Recognised compliance qualification such as the ICA Diploma in Compliance, the CISI Diploma in Investment Compliance or equivalent. Based in the Isle of Man. Track record of direct FSA engagement.

Subject to regulatory approval, and after adequate training and familiarisation, the role holder will ultimately hold the following statutory positions: Compliance Officer, under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book. Ideally, Money Laundering Reporting Officer, under the IOM AML/CFT Code 2019. You must be able to satisfy the IOM FSA on competence, time commitment, accessibility and effective oversight. An initial familiarisation period may be agreed before specific statutory positions are formally transferred. Key Responsibilities: Discharge the statutory Compliance Officer role under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book, acting as primary point of contact with the IOM FSA. Maintain compliance monitoring programme, regulatory returns, statutory registers, policy suite and the authorisation of new SPV structures. Oversee periodic client reviews and approve higher-risk new business across the SPV book. Ideally hold the MLRO function, receive internal reports, liaise with the IOM Financial Intelligence Unit. Run group sanctions screening (OFSI, OFAC, EU, UN), customer due diligence and transaction monitoring proportionate to the group's exposure, with particular attention to maritime risk. Deliver annual AML/CFT training to employees and report to the relevant boards on financial crime risk. Maintain the compliance requirements and risk assessment suite, AML/CFT and policy suite, and report to the Board. Key Skills and Experience: Ideally minimum three years' compliance experience in regulated financial services. Working knowledge of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book and AML/CFT Code 2019. Recognised compliance qualification such as the ICA Diploma in Compliance, the CISI Diploma in Investment Compliance or equivalent. Based in the Isle of Man. Track record of direct FSA engagement.

Key Responsibilities: Provide strategic leadership, guidance, and support to the Head of People and Culture and the broader People and Culture team on all Employee Relations matters. Oversee the efficient management of ER matters including grievances, disciplinary processes, and employment contract drafting and review. Ensure ongoing compliance with labour legislation, basic conditions of employment, and union-related obligations. Lead negotiations and consultations in unionised environments where required. Minimum 5 years' demonstrated Employee Relations experience at management level, covering grievances, disciplinary matters, employment contracts, and collective agreements. Experience handling negotiations and consultations in a unionised environment (advantageous). Experience operating in a multi-national environment covering at least two jurisdictions (advantageous). Strong competencies in dispute resolution, employee advocacy, legal advisory and interpretation, and legal compliance. Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge ideas constructively and build effective working relationships at all levels. High attention to detail with strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills. About the role
As Senior Administrator, you will manage your own portfolio of client entities and be the person clients and colleagues rely on to keep them in good order. You will draft and review board minutes, resolutions, statutory filings and correspondence, and coordinate incorporations, annual returns, compliance filings and due diligence. You will also liaise with banks and other third parties on behalf of your clients, and make sure that every record is kept accurately and in line with current regulatory requirements.

What we're looking for
You will have at least four years' experience in a corporate service provider or fiduciary services environment. You will work with a high level of accuracy, stay well organised under pressure and manage your deadlines without needing to be chased. A professional qualification such as STEP or the Chartered Governance Qualifying Programme is important to us, and we are equally happy to hear from you if you are working towards one.

Why join us?
You will be based in our new offices at 10-12 Victoria Street, a modern and professional place to work in the heart of Douglas. You will join a positive, inclusive and forward-thinking team that is part of a respected firm with an excellent reputation in the industry. We will support your further training and development, and we offer real opportunities for professional growth and career progression. Salary is commensurate with experience.

How to apply
Ready to take the next step in your career with a company that values your contribution? Send your CV and a short covering letter to carlystratton@manavia.im. We would love to hear from you. To find out more, visit www.manavia.im/careers.

Manavia has a vacancy for a Senior Administrator, eGaming Operations. The role suits a senior eGaming administrator who is looking for a new challenge or ready to take the next step in their career.

About the role
You will be responsible for managing all of the administrative, regulatory and compliance requirements across a portfolio of eGaming clients. You will build close working relationships with the licensed operators you look after, running regular client meetings and supporting them through the licensing process. You will maintain their policies, procedures and regulatory reporting, help to develop and implement the team's processes and procedures, and work across the wider group of companies.

About you
You will have at least three years' experience within the trust and corporate service provider (TCSP) industry, and you will be approved by the Isle of Man Gambling Supervision Commission and Financial Services Authority to act as a director of client companies. You will bring a strong knowledge of eGaming operations, regulation and compliance, and the organisational skills to manage a busy portfolio with minimal supervision. Your written and verbal communication will be strong, and you will be discreet, with a natural ability to build honest, transparent and close working relationships both inside the firm and with clients. You will hold, or be working towards, a relevant professional qualification, or be qualified by experience.

Why join us?
We offer a competitive salary, a friendly working environment and genuine opportunities to progress your career. You will be based in our new offices at 10-12 Victoria Street, Douglas, as part of a team that has grown alongside the Island's eGaming sector.

How to apply
Please send your CV and covering letter to info@manavia.im, or by post to Manavia Limited, 10-12 Victoria Street, Douglas, Isle of Man. To find out more, visit www.manavia.im/careers.

We are looking for someone bright, organised, proactive and experienced who can take direction and then independently get things done.
This is a hands-on role supporting People and Operations, with a strong focus on coordination, follow-through and keeping things moving.
You will work closely with management and will be trusted to take a task or project from instruction through to completion. You should be comfortable managing multiple priorities, following up with people, keeping documentation organised and identifying what needs to happen next without always being asked.
The role will suit someone who enjoys variety and is comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change and there is always something to get involved in.
esponsibilities

People & Recruitment

Coordinate recruitment activities and candidate sourcing, including preparing and posting job advertisements, conducting initial applicant screening and shortlisting, and scheduling and coordinating interviews. Manage candidate communication and follow-ups throughout the recruitment process, as well as coordinating reference and background checks. Support onboarding and offboarding administration, liaise with EORs, payroll providers and other external people-service providers, and prepare and maintain employee documentation. Ensure People records are accurate and up to date, coordinate leave and people-related calendars, support employee communications and People initiatives, and coordinate staff events, gifts and employee recognition initiatives.

People Processes & Documentation

Assist with the preparation and maintenance of People policies and procedures. Prepare training guides, onboarding materials and internal documentation, coordinate training activities, and ensure relevant materials are available and kept up to date. Prepare first drafts of performance-related correspondence and documentation based on management direction, support performance review and employee feedback processes, and ensure People-related actions, deadlines and follow-ups are tracked and completed.

Operations & Project Support

Provide general operational and administrative support across the business and assist management with operational projects and initiatives. Coordinate tasks and actions across different teams and stakeholders, follow up on agreed actions to ensure work is completed within the required timeframes, and maintain trackers, documents and internal systems. Assist with the implementation and improvement of processes, coordinate with external suppliers and service providers where required, and support ad-hoc projects and tasks as the business evolves.

NB: Experience Requirements
2 years Previous experience in recruitment, operations, administration, coordination or a similar role. Experience in a startup, scale-up or fast-paced environment would be advantageous. Recruitment coordination or People administration experience would be beneficial. Fluent English.

Mentoring junior members of the team and contributing to best practice within the change team. Key Skills and Experience: At least 4 years' experience as a Business Analyst, preferably in the life assurance industry. Excellent analytical skills and a sharp problem-solving mindset. A proven track record of supporting business improvement, operational efficiencies, digital transformation and technology-enabled change. Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks, including financial reporting and risk management. Hands-on experience working in Agile, Scrum, product-led or hybrid delivery environments, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritisation and iterative delivery. Ability to learn and take on knowledge of Isle of Man Gambling Supervision Commission and United Kingdom Gambling Commission's and Jersey Gambling Commission legislation. Innovative and strategic thinking. Well-developed communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with difficult customers. Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Sound interpersonal and negotiation skills. One year's relevant experience in a similar Compliance role is preferable but not essential as full training will be provided. Fluent English communication skills - written and verbal. Notes
Compliance Administrator - (Part-Time 14 - 21 Hours a week). Our client seeks a diligent and detail-oriented Compliance Administrator to support the compliance framework. You will assist the Head of Compliance and Directors in ensuring that the business meets its statutory, regulatory, and internal governance obligations. Key Responsibilities: Assist with customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) checks for new and existing clients. Conduct periodic reviews of client files to ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and up to date. Perform screening of clients, beneficial owners, and connected parties. Support the identification and escalation of suspicious activity in line with internal procedures.Help maintain compliance registers, including breaches, complaints, PEPs, sanctions, and training logs. Assist in monitoring compliance with the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority's Regulatory and AML/CFT Frameworks. Support thematic reviews, and business risk assessments. Contribute to the preparation of compliance reports for the board. Assist in drafting, updating and maintaining compliance policies and procedures. Help ensure staff are aware of regulatory changes and internal policy updates. Respond to internal queries about compliance, CDD requirements, and regulatory obligations. Assist with onboarding processes and ongoing monitoring workflows. Support the Client Services team in improving data quality within Reverto. Key Skills and Experience: Essential: Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Good understanding of Isle of Man AML/CFT and regulatory expectations. Excellent organisational and time-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication abilities. Ability to work with confidential information with discretion and professionalism. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office. 5 GCSEs or equivalent at grade C or above. Desirable: Experience within a TCSP, fiduciary, or financial services environment. Familiarity with IOMFSA Rulebook, AML/CFT Code, and relevant legislation. Working knowledge of screening tools and Reverto. Progress toward a relevant qualification (for example, certificate in regulation, AML or Trust Estate Practitioner). 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16850

Monitor the actioning of minute items to ensure agreed deadlines are met. Conduct financial and budget management duties across the project, including the updating of budgets with actuals, reconciling the financial entries against project budgets, the processing of invoices and claims and highlighting any financial discrepancies identified to ensure sound project financial management and reporting. Conduct onboarding and off boarding for all support staff, contractors and vendors to ensure they are fully equipped with the required information, access and hardware to fully exercise the requirements of their role within the project. Coordinate project workflow, activities and schedules across all project team members to ensure workload is effectively managed and deadlines are met. Drive and maintain the projects documentation management system to ensure that all project documentation is adequately and securely stored, version control is maintained and formats are adhered to, therefore enabling project governance and ensuring all project information is easily accessible. Key Skills and Experience: Diploma in Project Management. 3 - 4 years experience in Business Support role/environment. Experience in end-to-end administrative and secretarial duties across a programme or project environment, this includes documentation management, diary management and budget administration.

Notes
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and trustworthy Personal Assistant to provide day-to-day support across both personal and property-related matters.

This is a varied role that would suit someone who enjoys taking responsibility, is confident managing multiple priorities and has excellent attention to detail. Experience in property management would be highly desirable, although the right candidate with strong organisational and administrative skills will also be considered.

The Role
The successful candidate will provide a combination of personal, administrative and property management support. Responsibilities may include: Managing calendars, appointments and day-to-day schedules, Organising travel, bookings and arrangements, Handling correspondence, emails and telephone calls, Managing personal and business administration, Coordinating household and property-related matters, Liaising with tenants, contractors, tradespeople, agents and other suppliers, Arranging and overseeing maintenance and repairs, Obtaining quotes and helping to coordinate contractors, Keeping records of properties, maintenance, and other relevant documentation, Following up outstanding tasks and ensuring matters are dealt with promptly, Researching and sourcing suppliers, services and other requirements, Handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion, Providing general administrative and organisational support as required.

About You
We are looking for someone who is: Highly organised and able to manage multiple tasks and priorities, 
Proactive, dependable and able to work independently, Discreet and trustworthy when dealing with confidential information, An excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, Confident dealing with contractors, suppliers and professional contacts, Comfortable using email, calendars, Microsoft Office and other administrative systems, Detail-oriented, with a practical and solutions-focused approach, 
Flexible and willing to take on a varied range of responsibilities, Professional, personable and confident in representing the employer when dealing with others.
What We Offer
A varied and interesting role with considerable responsibility, A modern, friendly and professional, working environment, Flexibility where appropriate, The opportunity to become a trusted and integral part of the team, Private Health Insurance (after completing 6 months of employment),
Airport Parking. 

How to Apply
If you are an organised, capable and trustworthy individual who enjoys being proactive and getting things done, we would love to hear from you. Please send your CV and a brief covering letter outlining your experience and why you feel you would be suited to the role to claudia@mop.im.

The family has six children, five of whom are school-aged and attend school during the day. The youngest child is 2 years old and is at home during the day, so the role will primarily involve caring for the youngest child during school hours, alongside supporting the wider family routine before and after school.

Our preferred working arrangement is Monday to Friday, approximately 7am–7pm, on a one-week-on, one-week-off basis. This provides the successful candidate with every alternate week away from work.

However, we appreciate that experienced childcare professionals are in high demand and are happy to consider alternative working patterns or hours for the right candidate. We would therefore encourage applicants to get in touch even if they are unable to accommodate the preferred schedule.

Responsibilities will include providing attentive and engaging care for the youngest child, supporting morning and after-school routines, preparing children's meals and snacks where required, helping with children's laundry and organisation, assisting with school and activity arrangements, and generally helping to ensure the children's day-to-day routines run smoothly.

We are looking for someone who is warm, patient and confident caring for children of different ages. The successful candidate should be organised, dependable and proactive, with the ability to use their own initiative while working as part of a busy family household.

Previous professional childcare or nannying experience would be highly desirable. Relevant childcare qualifications and paediatric first-aid training would also be advantageous.

A full driving licence would be beneficial due to the nature of the role.

We offer a competitive rate of pay, dependent upon experience and the working arrangements agreed with the successful candidate.

To apply, please send your CV to allison@trillionmediagroup.com together with a short introduction outlining your childcare experience, availability and preferred working arrangements.

Notes
Build your career in New Homes Sales with Dandara!

Are you a natural people person who loves delivering great customer service? Looking for an exciting career opportunity where your personality, enthusiasm and ambition matter just as much as your experience?

At Dandara, we don't just build houses – we create beautiful homes and communities where people love to live.

We're looking for a friendly, motivated and customer-focused New Homes Sales Consultant to join our Isle of Man team, helping customers find their perfect home.

You don't need previous experience in new homes sales to join us. We're keen to hear from people with backgrounds in retail, hospitality, customer service, estate agency or other sales environments who are looking to take their next career step. This role will be based at our Douglas Sales Office.

If you're confident, approachable, organised and eager to learn, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

As a New Homes Sales Consultant, you'll be the welcoming face of Dandara, helping customers through one of the most exciting and important purchases they'll ever make.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
Making a great first impression – welcoming prospective buyers to our developments and show homes, creating a friendly and professional experience.
Helping customers find their dream home – understanding what they're looking for, showcasing our properties and explaining the features and benefits of each home.

Building lasting relationships – supporting customers throughout their homebuying journey, from their initial enquiry through to receiving their keys.
Supporting the sales process – responding to enquiries, arranging viewings, following up with potential purchasers and helping secure reservations.
Personalising the experience – helping customers explore optional extras and upgrades to make their new home their own.
Working together – liaising with colleagues, mortgage advisers and legal representatives to ensure sales progress smoothly.
Keeping things organised – maintaining accurate customer records, updating our sales system and ensuring our show homes and sales areas always look their best.
Creating memorable moments – helping with home demonstrations and preparing for the exciting day customers collect their keys.
Learning about the local market – developing your understanding of our Isle of Man developments, available properties and the wider housing market.

What we're looking for
We're looking for someone with the right attitude, personality and potential. Previous property sales experience would be welcome, but it's certainly not essential.
Ideally, you'll have:
Experience in a customer-facing role, whether that's retail, hospitality, customer service, sales or a similar environment.
A full driving licence.
Flexibility to work weekends as part of your normal working week.

Please apply here to this role - https://careers.dandara.com/jobs/8575717-new-homes-sales-consultant

Notes
Make a difference !!!  

Looking for something less ordinary? A rewarding role with meaning? Incredible job satisfaction? We may have just the role for you. 
 
Join a friendly, professional and dedicated reception team, working on a full time basis. We are privileged to have some of the most amazing customers, who in turn deserve excellent customer service and care. We are not a 9 to 5 profession, therefore you will be required to undertake early starts 08.00 and late finishes 18.30 on a rota basis, along with participation in a Saturday morning rota (approximately 1 in 4). 
 
Full time team members (37.50 hours per week) could benefit from a condensed-style rota which in turn could offer a day off during the working week, offering that much needed work/life balance. As one of the longest standing Veterinary Practices on the Isle of Man with branches in Douglas, Onchan, Ramsey, Castletown and Peel. It is important that you are able to provide cover at all our branches as and when it may be required, therefore a valid driving licence is preferable. 

We are looking for candidates that can work on their own initiative, are adaptable, and understanding that the role involves much more than front desk duties.  Some of the duties included alongside customer care are daily administrative tasks, maintaining branch environments including cleaning, supporting the nursing and veterinary teams where needed and ensuring everything behind the scenes runs smoothly.  
 
We offer standard (pro rata) 35 days annual leave inclusive of public holidays, birthday leave, additional length of service leave, cycle to work scheme, exclusive staff discounts, contributory pension scheme and access to private health care. The opportunity to grow and develop, gaining a recognised Veterinary Reception qualification. 
 
Think you've got what it takes? A love for animals? Excellent customer service skills? Friendly and caring? If so, send your CV and covering email for the attention of Craig Uren – Customer Care and Finance Manager to craig.uren@iomvet.co.uk  Closing date for applications is Friday 6th November 2026

Our client seeks an experienced Senior Client Services Administrator to join their team. The ideal candidate will have proven experience of working within a regulated environment for a Corporate Service Provider and confidently manage a portfolio of asset-owning companies. This role would suit someone who is driven to continually expand their knowledge and develop their skills, contributing positively to team and client success. Key Responsibilities: Manage and administer a portfolio of corporate entities, many of which are aircraft or yacht holding. Act as a key point of contact for clients, intermediaries, government departments, registries and stakeholders. Maintain statutory records and carry out all company secretarial duties including company incorporations/dissolutions, regulatory and statutory filings, completion of annual returns, arranging and attendance at board meetings, preparing minutes and resolutions. Key Skills & Experience: Previous experience of managing a client portfolio within a regulated Trust and Corporate Service Provider, with full ownership and accountability for client structures and relationships. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, applying sound professional judgement to resolve problems and communicate clear, decisive solutions, escalating where appropriate. Strong communication and organisational skills. An enthusiastic, proactive and adaptable approach to work. Self-motivated with a willingness to undertake further on the job training and continual personal development. Ideally, have an understanding of business aviation and/or yachting. A second language would be an advantage.

Ability to deliver quality and timely results, working under pressure and to tight deadlines. Able to take accountability and responsibility for own personal development. Highly motivated in providing exceptional levels of service. Self-confident and an able speaker with excellent interpersonal skills. Strong organisational skills, flexibility and logic. Able to work confidently alone as well as being able to work as part of a team. Competent in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook. A working knowledge of the e-gaming industry. Experience of Viewpoint administration system. STEP qualified or working towards a relevant qualification would be desirable.

Able to work on own initiative and as part of a team.

Notes
As a Commercial Plumber, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, testing and repair of plumbing systems within commercial buildings, including offices, schools, hospitals, and industrial facilities. The ideal candidate will have experience working with large-scale plumbing systems, ensuring compliance with Regulations such as Health and Safety and Approved Codes of Practice while delivering high-quality workmanship.

Key Responsibilities
1. Installation Work
Install and commission new plumbing systems, including water distribution, heating, sanitary ware, pipework, drainage, and plantroom equipment.
Interpret and work from technical drawings, specifications, and job instructions.
Ensure compliance with BS EN standards, the Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations, and manufacturer requirements.

2. Maintenance & Repairs
Perform reactive and planned preventative maintenance (PPM) on plumbing and/or gas systems including:
Pipework and valves
Booster sets and hot water systems
Pressurisation units
Thermostatic mixing valves (TMVs)
Diagnose and rectify faults efficiently to minimise downtime and disruption.
Inspect, test and service equipment in line with industry standards.

3. Compliance & Certification
Ensure compliance with relevant legislation including:
UK: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999, Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998 (if applicable), Building Regulations Part G.
Isle of Man: Building Regulations 2014 and associated technical standards, including plumbing, water heating and drainage.
Complete documentation such as commissioning records, service reports, and compliance certificates.
Work in accordance with Legionella prevention guidance (e.g. L8/HSG274 and Isle of Man equivalents).
Gas Safe registration and Core gas qualification is desireable.

For more details and to apply contact careers@ifg.im or 01624603660.

As a Commercial Plumber, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, testing and repair of plumbing systems within commercial buildings, including offices, schools, hospitals, and industrial facilities. The ideal candidate will have experience working with large-scale plumbing systems, ensuring compliance with Regulations such as Health and Safety and Approved Codes of Practice while delivering high-quality workmanship.

Key Responsibilities
1. Installation Work
Install and commission new plumbing systems, including water distribution, heating, sanitary ware, pipework, drainage, and plantroom equipment.
Interpret and work from technical drawings, specifications, and job instructions.
Ensure compliance with BS EN standards, the Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations, and manufacturer requirements.

2. Maintenance & Repairs
Perform reactive and planned preventative maintenance (PPM) on plumbing and/or gas systems including:
Pipework and valves
Booster sets and hot water systems
Pressurisation units
Thermostatic mixing valves (TMVs)
Diagnose and rectify faults efficiently to minimise downtime and disruption.
Inspect, test and service equipment in line with industry standards.

3. Compliance & Certification
Ensure compliance with relevant legislation including:
UK: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999, Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998 (if applicable), Building Regulations Part G.
Isle of Man: Building Regulations 2014 and associated technical standards, including plumbing, water heating and drainage.
Complete documentation such as commissioning records, service reports, and compliance certificates.
Work in accordance with Legionella prevention guidance (e.g. L8/HSG274 and Isle of Man equivalents).
Gas Safe registration and Core gas qualification is desireable.

For more details and to apply contact careers@ifg.im or 01624603660.

Everything we do starts with the people we serve. We’re proud to be the traders behind the tradespeople: the nuts and bolts behind the job, always ready to save the day (or at least the project).

From power tools to workwear, cables to pipe fittings, we offer over 60,000 products across 900+ stores – and that’s not to mention our industry-leading digital services. Join Screwfix and be part of a team of experts who get the job done quickly, affordably, and always with a smile.

You’ll be a vital part of the team, getting stuck in and leading by example. Whether you’re front-of-house helping customers or in the warehouse keeping our standards high, customers are always at the front of your mind. And with the help of our excellent training programmes and varied shift patterns to support a healthy work life balance, you’ll be on the right track for a promising career with us!

YOU ARE…

An experienced supervisor or duty manager who is used to managing a small team in a fast-paced environment
Great at giving amazing customer service, and able to translate that into sales
Inquisitive, ever-questioning and ever-improving
Passionate about our business
Friendly, flexible, reliable, honest and like to work hard!
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Joining Screwfix means joining a growing team – full of support, opportunities, and fun!
We offer a competitive salary
28 days annual leave (including an allowance for Bank Holidays). Increasing with length of service, up to a maximum of 33 days annual leave.
Award-winning company pension scheme - up to 14% Kingfisher contribution!
Life cover
20% discount with Screwfix and B&Q
Discounted healthcare
Company share save schemes
We’ll also help you be the best you can be, with excellent training and ongoing development.
To find out more about us, please email careers@screwfix.com for any queries

Follow us and find out more on our LinkedIn, Instagram & Twitter pages

Apply now! – Upload your CV and complete your application

*Our hourly rates may include a location allowance which is reviewed annually and may change.

Our policy is to employ the best qualified people and provide equal opportunity for the advancement of employees including promotion and training and not to discriminate against any person because of gender, race, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief or disability.

If you require any additional support or adjustments to help you make an application, please contact us at careers@screwfix.com

Salary: £27,00.00 - £32,000.00 per annum Dependent on Experience
SOC Code: 3115

About the Role
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Quality Control Analyst to join our Quality Control team in the Isle of Man. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the testing and release of specialist products while supporting quality standards, laboratory operations and continuous improvement initiatives. This role offers exposure to a variety of analytical techniques and opportunities to develop within a regulated laboratory environment.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct testing of raw materials, intermediates and finished products, maintain laboratory records, perform environmental monitoring activities, support equipment maintenance and calibration, assist with investigations, train colleagues and contribute to continuous improvement activities.
About You
A degree in a scientific discipline is desirable, together with strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work independently. Previous laboratory experience within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or chemical manufacturing environment would be advantageous.
Working Environment
Laboratory-based role involving analytical testing, the use of laboratory equipment and adherence to quality and safety procedures. The role may require occasional flexibility to support operational requirements.
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work within a quality-focused environment, gain experience across a range of analytical techniques and products, and develop your skills through ongoing training and professional development.

If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity within a quality control environment, we would love to hear from you.
Closing Date: 31st October 2026.

Please apply via this link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/8333782-qc-analyst-astrea

Key Responsibilities
Manufacture chromatography products and materials, follow SOPs, maintain production records, conduct quality control activities, support process optimisation studies, maintain equipment, train colleagues and contribute to continuous improvement activities.
About You
Computer literate with strong attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to work independently. Scientific qualifications and manufacturing experience are desirable.
Working Environment
Laboratory-based role involving standing for extended periods, manual equipment operation and participation in a 24/7 shift-working environment.
Why Join Us?
Comprehensive internal training, exposure to diverse products and processes, and opportunities for development within the business.
Apply Now
If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity within a growing manufacturing environment, we would love to hear from you.
